verdict.rationale: Figma's docs claim high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes (figma-docs-16/33) and precise animations with reusable motion systems (figma-docs-28), which covers the animation part of the story. The evidence does not show conditions, prototype variables or scroll effects. The variables material is about design tokens and the REST API, not prototype logic. Missing for 10: evidence of conditional logic or variables driving prototype behavior, scroll effects (e.g. sticky or overflow scrolling), animation between component states specifically, and independent hands-on corroboration.
